description: This file defines structures and functions for reading and parsing file descriptor information, including inotify details, from the /proc filesystem in Linux. It is part of the 'procfs' package used for system introspection.

classes.name: ProcFDInfo
classes.description: Represents file descriptor information including position, flags, mount ID, inode, and inotify details.

classes.name: InotifyInfo
classes.description: Represents a single inotify line with watch descriptor, inode, device ID, and mask.

methods.name: FDInfo
methods.description: Reads and parses fdinfo data for a given file descriptor, returning a ProcFDInfo object.

methods.name: parseInotifyInfo
methods.description: Parses a line of inotify information into an InotifyInfo object.

methods.name: InotifyWatchLen
methods.description: Calculates the total number of inotify watches across a list of ProcFDInfo objects.
